home.purpose: Root entry point — redirects authenticated users to the home tab or unauthenticated users to onboarding

tabs-home.purpose: Home tab — main dashboard showing profile summary, featured games, quizzes, and player cards

discovery.purpose: Discovery tab — browse featured games and content with category filters and highlight banners

events.purpose: Events tab — lists available games and special events with navigation to individual game screens

profile.purpose: Profile tab — displays user avatar, points balance, badges, transaction history, and vouchers

rewards.purpose: Rewards tab — browsable catalogue of redeemable rewards with category filters and wishlist support

account.purpose: Account page — manage account settings and preferences

login.purpose: Login page — authenticates an existing user with email and password

register.purpose: Registration page — creates a new user account with email and password

avatar-builder.purpose: Avatar builder — full customisation screen for choosing gender, personality, interests, accessories, and style

avatar-camera.purpose: Avatar camera modal — opens the device camera to capture a live photo for avatar generation

avatar-creation.purpose: Avatar creation page — capture or upload a photo to generate an AI football trading card avatar

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Optional mode flag; pass 'onboarding' to trigger the onboarding-specific post-creation flow

games-memory-match.purpose: Memory match game — soccer-themed card matching game that awards points on completion

games-penalty-rivals.purpose: Penalty rivals game — competitive penalty shootout mechanic that awards points on completion

games-puzzle.purpose: Puzzle game — sliding puzzle mechanic that awards points on completion

games-scratch-card.purpose: Scratch card game — scratch-to-reveal mechanic that awards points on completion

games-spin-wheel.purpose: Spin wheel game — animated prize wheel mechanic that awards points on completion

onboarding-step-1-value-prop.purpose: Onboarding step 1 — value proposition screen introducing the app's key benefits

onboarding-step-2-brands.purpose: Onboarding step 2 — brand selection screen where the user picks favourite brands

onboarding-step-3-avatar.purpose: Onboarding step 3 — avatar selection and creation screen

onboarding-step-4-interests.purpose: Onboarding step 4 — interests selection screen for content personalisation

onboarding-step-5-register.purpose: Onboarding step 5 — account registration screen completing the onboarding flow

quizzes.purpose: Quizzes list page — displays available quiz categories with cover images

quiz-category.purpose: Dynamic quiz page — loads and runs a quiz for the given category slug

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Category identifier for the quiz (e.g. sport, cinema, music, technology, travels, general-culture)

quiz-of-the-day.purpose: Quiz of the day — loads and runs a specific daily quiz identified by quizId

parameters.name: quizId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the daily quiz to load; defaults to the configured FIFA World Cup quiz

reward-detail.purpose: Reward detail page — shows full reward information and allows the user to redeem it for points

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique article identifier of the reward

parameters.name: article_name
parameters.description: Display name of the reward article

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Full description of the reward

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand name associated with the reward

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category the reward belongs to

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Monetary value of the reward

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency code for the reward value (e.g. USD, GBP)

parameters.name: cost_points
parameters.description: Number of points required to redeem this reward

parameters.name: stock_available
parameters.description: Whether stock is available for redemption (true/false)

parameters.name: thumbnail_url
parameters.description: URL of the reward thumbnail image

parameters.name: country_code
parameters.description: Country code for the reward availability

parameters.name: delivery_type
parameters.description: Delivery method for the reward (e.g. digital, physical)

parameters.name: currentBalance
parameters.description: User's current points balance, used for affordability check

parameters.name: isWishlisted
parameters.description: Whether the reward is in the user's wishlist (true/false)

voucher-result.purpose: Voucher result page — displays redeemed voucher details including code, PIN, and instructions after a successful redemption

parameters.name: article_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the redeemed reward article

parameters.name: article_name
parameters.description: Display name of the redeemed reward

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand name of the redeemed reward

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Monetary value of the redeemed reward

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency code for the redeemed reward value

parameters.name: cost_points
parameters.description: Points spent to redeem this voucher

parameters.name: voucher_code
parameters.description: The redemption code for the voucher

parameters.name: voucher_pin
parameters.description: Optional PIN associated with the voucher

parameters.name: voucher_url
parameters.description: Optional URL to redeem or use the voucher online

parameters.name: voucher_instructions
parameters.description: Redemption instructions for the voucher

parameters.name: created_at
parameters.description: ISO timestamp of when the voucher was redeemed

parameters.name: thumbnail_url
parameters.description: URL of the reward thumbnail image

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: Navigation origin used to determine the back-navigation target after viewing the voucher

whoami.purpose: Routing manifest — returns the full URL mapping structure of this application as JSON
